setup_worktree_environment(worktree_path: str, backend_port: int, frontend_port: int, logger: logging.Logger) -> None
    Set up worktree environment by creating .pinata/ namespace and installing dependencies.

    This automatically:
    1. Creates .pinata/{specs,docs,logs,reports,agents}/ subdirectories
    2. Writes .pinata/.gitignore to exclude runtime artifacts
    3. Creates .pinata/ports.env with port configuration
    4. Installs npm workspace dependencies (npm install at repo root)

    Args:
        worktree_path: Path to the worktree
        backend_port: Backend port number
        frontend_port: Frontend port number
        logger: Logger instance
